Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.persist

Record Class HighScoreTable.Entry

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.persist.HighScoreTable.Entry
Record Components:
score - final score
name - adventurer's name
depth - deepest depth reached
outcome - how the run ended
difficulty - difficulty played
turns - turns taken
seed - run seed
date - when the run ended, as text (e.g. "2026-11-09")
Enclosing class:
HighScoreTable
public static record HighScoreTable.Entry(int score, String name, int depth, GamePhase outcome, Difficulty difficulty, int turns, long seed, String date) extends Record
One finished run.
